result:
**Decision: CONTINUE.** Round 423 is the first half of the regression round REGRESSION-2026-11-10. C re-checks in the browser everything finished in rounds 391–422; A changes no code.

**Round 422 accepted.** I accepted it from C's evidence only: C PASS on all 8 rows, the browser check ran, 0 bugs. Root's gate published it as `875ff37`, with all 264 test files and 3,957 tests passing. That commit is the baseline for round 423.
- GATE107-S1 (held Enter on a marker flag) is closed.
- A-R107 (the held-Enter sweep over the remaining buttons) stays open for SYS-2 stage 2.
- Two new Lows go to the deferred-polish list: A-R422-REVIEW-L1 (handler order on three buttons) and -L2 (two weak test rows). The gate reviewer's third Low duplicates an already-accepted finding, so it got no new id.
- The reviewer's suggestion of one shared repeat-safe button helper is recorded as an architecture signal. It will be decided inside SYS-2 stage 2a, not as a separate task.

**Why the regression now.** The last regression was 2026-11-07. I planned at 2026-11-09 23:10 UTC, so the 3-day trigger was about an hour away, and A and C will run on 2026-11-10. The rule sets a minimum interval, not an exact date, and round 389 opened a day early on the same reasoning. A SYS-2 stage 2 task could not have been built and pre-checked before midnight anyway.

**Round 423 task (`current-task.md`):**
- **17 browser rows**, one short check per item finished in rounds 391–422, at both 1440×900 and 1280×720. Each reuses that round's script and passing result as the expected outcome.
- **Scope additions:** all six from the backlog are named rows (SA-1 to SA-6).
- **One new check, marker seek, which I ran on the live server first.** With a marker at 00:09, Home then Next marker lands on 00:09. Without a marker it lands on 00:16, so the check tells the two apart.
- **Suite rows:** the perf suite runs alone, plus the perf library tests, `test:e2e:smoke` and the auth guard. The fake-bearer auth path stays BLOCKED because there is no backend in the cloud.
- **Outcome rules are fixed in advance.** Round 424 runs the second half (the round-390 template, everything up to round 390), unless C finds a Critical, High or Medium bug, which gets a fix-up round first. `regression-last.json` is updated only when the second half closes.

**Recorded but not dispatched.** SYS-2 stage 2 has about 40 remaining buttons across about 12 files, too many for one round. I split it by owner without dropping anything: 2a covers the lane, group, master and metronome controls plus the shared-helper decision; 2b covers the library, video dock, menus, dialogs, and held Escape in the marker editor. Fit stays unguarded, as an existing test (TH5) requires.

**Advisor:** available and used twice. The second call found six gaps, and I fixed all of them. The main ones were that one claims line would have broken when closed ids are archived, some expected results were paraphrased instead of cited, and three old scripts write into their own round folders, so their rows now name the path change.

**Checks:** the claims script exits 0 with empty stderr and gives the same output after my last edit. The sketch check passes (there is no sketch this round), and the C-JSON field check on `c-round-422.json` passes. The store tree is unchanged.
